items.title: Stalks of higher direct images along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism as cohomology of the strict henselization
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The theorem identifies the stalk of a higher direct image along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism at a geometric point with the cohomology of the base change to the strict henselization, and states the same for bounded below complexes (statement lines 8014-8038). The proof first writes the stalk as a filtered colimit of cohomology groups over the etale neighbourhoods of the geometric point, using the Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence (proof lines 8040-8066), and then identifies cohomology over the strict henselization with that same colimit, which gives the sheaf case, the derived case following by taking a representative complex (proof lines 8066-8094). The non-formal content is the identification of the two colimits. The claim is H2: two comparisons of colimits, both written out.
